title: A Phase IIb Study to Evaluate AZD8965 in Participants with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)
official: A Phase IIb Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Tolerability of AZD8965 in Participants with Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF)) (ARGiNAUT)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the clinical efficacy of AZD8965 compared with placebo on the absolute change from baseline in FVC in mL at Week 24
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. 1. Age ≥ 40 years
2. 2. IPF diagnosis
3. 3. Participants with IPF receiving locally approved antifibrotic therapies at a stable dose, or participants with IPF not receiving local standard of care
4. 4. FVC ≥ 45% predicted of normal
5. 5. DLCO corrected for hemoglobin ≥ 25% predicted of normal
Exclusion criteria:
1. 1. ILD other than IPF
2. 2. The extent of emphysema is greater than the extent of fibrotic changes on chest HRCT scan
3. 3. Acute exacerbation of IPF
4. 4. Lower respiratory tract infection requiring treatment
5. 5. Acute coronary syndrome/acute myocardial infarction, unstable angina ± coronary intervention with Percutaneous Coronary Intervention, or Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
6. 6. Heart failure
7. 7. History of organ transplantation or is likely to receive lung transplantation
